lines.text: The LORD is jealous for Zion and will return to dwell in Jerusalem, the City of Truth.
Old men and old women will sit along Jerusalem's streets with staffs, while boys and girls play there.
The LORD will save His people from the land of the north and the west.
The people must speak truth to one another, render sound judgments in their gates, and not plot evil against neighbors.
The fasts of the fourth, fifth, ninth, and tenth months will become times of joy and gladness.
